purpose: Record primary government updates about current Cagayan River research and distinguish microbial work, ecological-health assessment, reconnaissance and any future fish checklist.

program.name: Cagayan BAYRUS-DIVERSITY Program
partners: University of Santo Tomas Research Center for the Natural and Applied Sciences
program.fundingAsReported: DOST-National Research Council of the Philippines

components.name: BAYRUS-ILOG
components.scopeAsReported: Bacteria and bacteriophage diversity, interaction, lytic activity and genomic profiling in the Cagayan River.

components.name: Lusog-Ilog
components.scopeAsReported: Assessment of river-system ecological health in support of sustainable fisheries and biodiversity conservation.

fieldworkLeads.permitStatusAsReported: The notice says full-scale sampling and data-collection permits were still being secured at that time.

localitiesAsReported: Unspecified selected municipalities along the Cagayan River
fieldworkLeads.coordinationOnlyLocality: The UST team visited Ilagan City officials to coordinate future research. This is not identified as a sampling station in the notice.

evidenceLimits: The April 2025 notice reports reconnaissance and initial water sampling, not fish collection.
The August 2025 notice reports river sampling but does not identify fish methods, fish taxa, exact stations, or the municipalities sampled.
BAYRUS-ILOG microbial scope does not support fish occurrence, fish diversity, or fish safety claims.
No vouchers, field sheets, coordinates, water-quality values, fish checklist or item-specific data reuse terms were found in the reviewed notices.
nextAction: Request or locate the completed Lusog-Ilog report and any fish-specific dataset. Confirm exact sampling municipalities/stations, field dates, methods, identifications, vouchers/photos and rights. Keep microbial BAYRUS-ILOG findings separate from fish evidence.

sources.supports: Official BFAR update on program scopes and April 2025 reconnaissance/water sampling in Peñablanca and Tuguegarao; no fish survey results.
Official BFAR update on August 2025 Cagayan River fieldwork; no fish taxa, methods or exact stations published.
